# Theme fixtures

Real theme files, kept as downloaded, that the importers are tested against. All of them are MIT-licensed.

| File | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| `dracula.itermcolors` | https://github.com/dracula/iterm |
| `dracula-alacritty.toml` | https://github.com/dracula/alacritty |
| `dracula-kitty.conf` | https://github.com/dracula/kitty |
| `dracula-windows-terminal.json` | https://github.com/dracula/windows-terminal |
| `catppuccin-mocha-kitty.conf` | https://github.com/catppuccin/kitty |
| `catppuccin-mocha-alacritty.toml` | https://github.com/catppuccin/alacritty |
| `catppuccin-mocha-ghostty` | https://github.com/catppuccin/ghostty |
| `catppuccin-mocha-windows-terminal.json` | https://github.com/catppuccin/windows-terminal |
